name: Experimental Field Generator
storytext: A product of the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering that has gone out of control due to an accident. It has the ability to "counteract" the effects of gravity.
source: Reward for accepting the Tavern Challenge at The Cat's Tail and claiming victory in a Friendly Fracas with Experimental Field Generator
